meta.name: automation
meta.description: Trigger-driven automation definitions and runner management. Use when creating, running, or managing skill-based automation pipelines.

copy.tagline: 把重复任务编排成自动触发的流水线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你想把多个技能串成自动运行的流水线
copy.tagline_en: Turn repetitive tasks into trigger-driven pipelines
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to chain multiple skills into automated workflows

howto.what: Claude能定义并运行由触发器驱动的自动化流水线，把GitHub事件、定时任务或文件变化连接到技能步骤，产出报告、评论等结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求创建、运行或管理自动化流水线，或提到 PR、定时任务、文件变化等触发条件时。

say.text: 创建一个自动化：每周一运行质量检查并生成报告。
say.note: 会创建YAML定义并定时执行。
立即执行安全审查流水线。

howto.what_en: Claude can define and run trigger-driven automation pipelines that connect events (GitHub, cron, file changes) to sequences of skill steps, producing outputs like reports, comments, or Slack messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to create, run, or manage automation pipelines, or mentions triggers such as GitHub events, cron schedules, or file changes.

say_en.text: Create an automation that runs quality checks weekly and generates a report.
say_en.note: Creates a cron job and outputs a report.
Executes the PR security review pipeline immediately.
